verdict.rationale: Recruitee documents first-party webhooks: you configure a URL and choose events, and Recruitee then sends HTTP POST requests whenever those events occur. A test button, a 30-day request log and a 'Manage webhooks' role permission round out the feature. missing for 10: a documented catalog of subscribable events, payload signing/verification details, retry/delivery semantics, programmatic (API-based) webhook registration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Once a webhook is configured, Recruitee will send HTTP POST requests to the given URL whenever one of the chosen events occurs.
Webhooks allow you to receive notifications when events happen in Recruitee.
The `Test` button prompts Recruitee to send a test request to your endpoint.
Every request is logged for 30 days.
a team member's role needs to have the "Manage webhooks" ability assigned in their hiring role under Add-ons.
